Invitation for MST 42 
You are invited to join the 42nd International Conference of the Microscopy Society of Thailand (MST42) that the Faculty of Science, Prince of Songkla University is co-organizing with the Microscopy Society of Thailand. This year’s theme, “Seeing the Invisible: How Microscopy Transforms Science and Industry”, celebrates the transformative power of microscopy in revealing hidden dimensions, advancing scientific discoveries, and driving innovations across a wide range of industrial fields.

Further conference details are as follows: 
 
📅Date: 9th - 12th June 2025 (Monday & Thursday)
 
👉 Pre-conference workshops on 9th of June 2025 at Office of Scientific Instrument and Testing, Prince of Songkla University, Hat Yai
 
📑 Optional Full Paper Submission: Opportunity to submit full papers for publication in
•	Conference Proceedings
•	Microscopy and Microanalysis Research (MMRES, a peer-reviewed journal)
•	Chiang Mai Journal of Science (indexed in ISI and Scopus)
•	Journal of Health Science and Medical Research (JHSMR, indexing in Scopus)
 
🌴Venue: Laguna Grand Spa Hotel & Spa, Songkhla (Thailand)
 
📍Up-to-date information, registration, and submission are available at https://www.microscopythailand.org/mst42/index.php
